titles.en: Reporting Regulation ZABIL-DL 1/2022 of the Oesterreichische Nationalbank on the statistical recording of cross-border trade in services

payload.officialRef: Meldeverordnung ZABIL-DL 1/2022 der Oesterreichischen Nationalbank, BGBl. II Nr. 510/2021

obligations.title: Add the duty: Report cross-border services for the year after the reporting threshold was reached, with nil reports if need be
obligations.sourceLabel: Rechtsinformationssystem des Bundes (RIS), Meldeverordnung ZABIL-DL 1/2022 der Oesterreichischen Nationalbank, BGBl. II Nr. 510/2021, § 18 Abs. 1 bis 3, consolidated text read through the RIS open-data interface

titles.en: Report cross-border services for the year after the reporting threshold was reached, with nil reports if need be

summaries.en: A credit institution, a branch under § 9 BWG, a financial institution under § 11 BWG or a pension fund in Austria that mainly works in banking and financial services, provides or buys cross-border services and reached the reporting threshold in the previous year must report for the four quarters of the following year. The duty runs to the end of those periods even if the threshold is no longer reached or no cross-border services occur, with nil reports.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Break down cross-border service exports and imports by type of service and country
obligations.sourceLabel: Rechtsinformationssystem des Bundes (RIS), Meldeverordnung ZABIL-DL 1/2022 der Oesterreichischen Nationalbank, BGBl. II Nr. 510/2021, § 17 Abs. 4 und 5, consolidated text read through the RIS open-data interface

titles.en: Break down cross-border service exports and imports by type of service and country

summaries.en: The reporting firm must report its exports and imports of cross-border services for the period by the types of service listed in the annex and by the country of the foreign provider or recipient with its ISO code, and give its OeNB identification number.

obligations.title: Add the duty: File the quarterly services report with the Nationalbank by the 15th of the following month
obligations.sourceLabel: Rechtsinformationssystem des Bundes (RIS), Meldeverordnung ZABIL-DL 1/2022 der Oesterreichischen Nationalbank, BGBl. II Nr. 510/2021, § 20 Abs. 1 bis 3, consolidated text read through the RIS open-data interface

titles.en: File the quarterly services report with the Nationalbank by the 15th of the following month

summaries.en: Reports are made to the Oesterreichische Nationalbank each quarter, for the calendar quarter in which the service was invoiced, and are due by the 15th calendar day of the month after the quarter.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Report card payment flows with foreign card organisations by country and merchant category
obligations.sourceLabel: Rechtsinformationssystem des Bundes (RIS), Meldeverordnung ZABIL-DL 1/2022 der Oesterreichischen Nationalbank, BGBl. II Nr. 510/2021, § 21 Abs. 1 bis 5, consolidated text read through the RIS open-data interface

titles.en: Report card payment flows with foreign card organisations by country and merchant category

summaries.en: A payment service provider that issues cards, acquires card payments or runs cash withdrawals at cash machines must report the amounts refunded by and to foreign card organisations for card transactions between residents and non-residents, by the country of the foreign party and by merchant category code, stating whether the card was present and whether the payment was initiated electronically, and give its OeNB identification number.

obligations.title: Add the duty: File the card payment report each quarter within 20 bank working days or with the payment statistics
obligations.sourceLabel: Rechtsinformationssystem des Bundes (RIS), Meldeverordnung ZABIL-DL 1/2022 der Oesterreichischen Nationalbank, BGBl. II Nr. 510/2021, § 23 Abs. 1 bis 5, consolidated text read through the RIS open-data interface

titles.en: File the card payment report each quarter within 20 bank working days or with the payment statistics

summaries.en: The card payment report is made to the Oesterreichische Nationalbank each quarter and is due 20 bank working days after the quarter ends. It counts as made when filed as part of the Nationalbank's payment statistics, the period then being the quarter in which the transaction took place.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Register in time, file the services reports electronically in German and correct them without delay
obligations.sourceLabel: Rechtsinformationssystem des Bundes (RIS), Meldeverordnung ZABIL-DL 1/2022 der Oesterreichischen Nationalbank, BGBl. II Nr. 510/2021, § 3 Abs. 1, 2, 3 und 10, consolidated text read through the RIS open-data interface

titles.en: Register in time, file the services reports electronically in German and correct them without delay

summaries.en: A reporting firm must file its reports electronically under the technical standards the OeNB or Statistics Austria publishes, in German, complete the registration and authentication steps in time before filing, and file a corrected report without delay where a report already filed needs to be corrected, completed or cut back.

instruments.title: Add Systemsicherheit von Zahlungssystemen, the Nationalbank's regulation on the safety of payment systems
instruments.sourceLabel: Rechtsinformationssystem des Bundes (RIS), Verordnung der Oesterreichischen Nationalbank zur Systemsicherheit von Zahlungssystemen, BGBl. II Nr. 198/2023, made by the Oesterreichische Nationalbank under § 44a Abs. 3 Nationalbankgesetz 1984 (title document: long title, gazette reference, preamble, amendments), read through the RIS open-data interface; consolidated text in force on 14 November 2026, not amended since the original version; entry into force read in § 26

titles.de: Verordnung der Oesterreichischen Nationalbank zur Systemsicherheit von Zahlungssystemen
titles.en: Regulation of the Oesterreichische Nationalbank on the safety of payment systems

payload.officialRef: Verordnung der Oesterreichischen Nationalbank zur Systemsicherheit von Zahlungssystemen, BGBl. II Nr. 198/2023

obligations.title: Add the duty: Notify the Nationalbank within two weeks of starting or stopping a payment system and of participant changes
obligations.sourceLabel: Rechtsinformationssystem des Bundes (RIS), Verordnung der Oesterreichischen Nationalbank zur Systemsicherheit von Zahlungssystemen, BGBl. II Nr. 198/2023, § 4 Abs. 1 und 2, consolidated text read through the RIS open-data interface

titles.en: Notify the Nationalbank within two weeks of starting or stopping a payment system and of participant changes

summaries.en: The operator of a payment system must notify the Oesterreichische Nationalbank electronically within two weeks when it starts or stops operating the system, with the system's name, its own name and seat and the names and seats of the participants, and within two weeks of each change of participants, with the new or departing participant's name, seat and type of participation.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Report major security and operational incidents of the payment system to the Nationalbank
obligations.sourceLabel: Rechtsinformationssystem des Bundes (RIS), Verordnung der Oesterreichischen Nationalbank zur Systemsicherheit von Zahlungssystemen, BGBl. II Nr. 198/2023, § 4 Abs. 3, consolidated text read through the RIS open-data interface

titles.en: Report major security and operational incidents of the payment system to the Nationalbank

summaries.en: The operator must report major security and operational incidents in the sense of the Major Incident Reporting Framework for Payment Schemes and Retail Payment Systems electronically on the standard templates of Annex 1. No further report is needed where the firm already reports under § 86 ZaDiG 2018.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Set up a sound risk management system for the payment system's legal, credit, liquidity and operational risks
obligations.sourceLabel: Rechtsinformationssystem des Bundes (RIS), Verordnung der Oesterreichischen Nationalbank zur Systemsicherheit von Zahlungssystemen, BGBl. II Nr. 198/2023, § 7, consolidated text read through the RIS open-data interface

titles.en: Set up a sound risk management system for the payment system's legal, credit, liquidity and operational risks

summaries.en: A payment system must set up a sound risk management system for the comprehensive management of legal, credit and liquidity risks and of operational and other risks.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Hold enough liquidity in every relevant currency to settle on the same day under stress
obligations.sourceLabel: Rechtsinformationssystem des Bundes (RIS), Verordnung der Oesterreichischen Nationalbank zur Systemsicherheit von Zahlungssystemen, BGBl. II Nr. 198/2023, § 10, consolidated text read through the RIS open-data interface

titles.en: Hold enough liquidity in every relevant currency to settle on the same day under stress

summaries.en: A payment system must measure, monitor and manage its liquidity risk effectively and hold enough liquid means in all relevant currencies to meet its payment obligations with high certainty on the same day, or at the latest on a following day, in a wide range of stress scenarios, including the default of the participant whose failure would cause the largest payment obligation in extreme but plausible market conditions.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Set clear rules and procedures for handling a participant's default
obligations.sourceLabel: Rechtsinformationssystem des Bundes (RIS), Verordnung der Oesterreichischen Nationalbank zur Systemsicherheit von Zahlungssystemen, BGBl. II Nr. 198/2023, § 14, consolidated text read through the RIS open-data interface

titles.en: Set clear rules and procedures for handling a participant's default

summaries.en: A payment system must establish effective and clearly defined rules and procedures for dealing with the default of a participant, designed so that it can contain losses and liquidity shortfalls in time and continue to meet its obligations.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Limit the payment system's operational risks and plan for the timely recovery of operations
obligations.sourceLabel: Rechtsinformationssystem des Bundes (RIS), Verordnung der Oesterreichischen Nationalbank zur Systemsicherheit von Zahlungssystemen, BGBl. II Nr. 198/2023, § 17, consolidated text read through the RIS open-data interface

titles.en: Limit the payment system's operational risks and plan for the timely recovery of operations

summaries.en: A payment system must identify internal and external sources of plausible operational risk and limit their effects with appropriate systems, policies, procedures and controls, be designed for a high degree of security and reliability with adequate scalable capacity, and plan for the timely recovery of operations and the meeting of its obligations, in particular after a wide-scale or major disruption.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Disclose the payment system's rules, procedures, risks and fees to participants
obligations.sourceLabel: Rechtsinformationssystem des Bundes (RIS), Verordnung der Oesterreichischen Nationalbank zur Systemsicherheit von Zahlungssystemen, BGBl. II Nr. 198/2023, § 23, consolidated text read through the RIS open-data interface

titles.en: Disclose the payment system's rules, procedures, risks and fees to participants

summaries.en: A payment system must have clear and comprehensive rules and procedures and give enough information for participants to understand the risks, fees and other material costs of taking part, and must disclose all relevant rules and its main procedures.

titles.de: Verordnung des Bundesministers für Finanzen über die Meldung der steuerrelevanten Daten für Investmentfonds, Immobilienfonds und AIF (Fonds-Melde-Verordnung 2015 – FMV 2015)
titles.en: Regulation of the Federal Minister of Finance on reporting the tax-relevant data of investment funds, real estate funds and AIFs (Fund Reporting Regulation 2015)

obligations.title: Add the duty: Register with the reporting office two weeks before the first fund tax report and keep master data current
obligations.sourceLabel: Rechtsinformationssystem des Bundes (RIS), Fonds-Melde-Verordnung 2015 (FMV 2015), BGBl. II Nr. 167/2015, § 2 Abs. 1, consolidated text read through the RIS open-data interface

titles.en: Register with the reporting office two weeks before the first fund tax report and keep master data current

summaries.en: A management company must register with the reporting office, giving the master data of Annex 1, at least two weeks before its first transmission, then report the master data of the reporting funds it manages under Annex 2, keep both up to date and report any change to the reporting office without delay.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Transmit the tax data of funds only by automated means in the structured form of the annexes
obligations.sourceLabel: Rechtsinformationssystem des Bundes (RIS), Fonds-Melde-Verordnung 2015 (FMV 2015), BGBl. II Nr. 167/2015, § 3 Abs. 1, consolidated text read through the RIS open-data interface

titles.en: Transmit the tax data of funds only by automated means in the structured form of the annexes

summaries.en: The tax-relevant data of distributions and deemed distributed income must be transmitted only by automated means in structured form as Annexes 3, 3a and 3b describe, meeting their plausibility criteria. A transmission made another way, incomplete or outside the procedure of Annex 3 is not a report and the reporting office does not accept it.

obligations.title: Add the duty: File the fund distribution report before the distribution day and the annual report within seven months
obligations.sourceLabel: Rechtsinformationssystem des Bundes (RIS), Fonds-Melde-Verordnung 2015 (FMV 2015), BGBl. II Nr. 167/2015, § 3 Abs. 2, consolidated text read through the RIS open-data interface

titles.en: File the fund distribution report before the distribution day and the annual report within seven months

summaries.en: The distribution report is due at the latest on the last day before the distribution date, and the annual report at the latest seven months after the end of the fund's financial year, or on the last day before a payment under § 58 Abs. 2 InvFG 2011. A report not made in time has the legal consequences of § 186 Abs. 2 Z 3 InvFG 2011 and § 40 Abs. 2 Z 2 ImmoInvFG.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Correct the capital gains tax withheld when a fund tax report is corrected, while the client relationship lasts
obligations.sourceLabel: Rechtsinformationssystem des Bundes (RIS), Fonds-Melde-Verordnung 2015 (FMV 2015), BGBl. II Nr. 167/2015, § 4 Abs. 1, consolidated text read through the RIS open-data interface

titles.en: Correct the capital gains tax withheld when a fund tax report is corrected, while the client relationship lasts

summaries.en: A timely report may be corrected only until 15 December of the year in which it was made. Where a report is corrected, the paying agent that withholds capital gains tax must correct the withholding and the tax values based on it, provided it still has a business relationship with the unit holder.

obligations.sourceLabel: Rechtsinformationssystem des Bundes (RIS), Festlegung von Gruppen sozial oder wirtschaftlich besonders schutzbedürftiger Verbraucher (VZKG-V), BGBl. II Nr. 255/2016, § 1 Z 1 bis 12, consolidated text read through the RIS open-data interface

titles.en: Apply the reduced basic account fee cap to consumers in the listed groups of especially vulnerable persons

summaries.en: For the reduced annual fee cap of a payment account with basic features, 40 instead of 80 euros under § 26 Abs. 2 VZKG, a credit institution must treat as especially vulnerable consumers who receive minimum income or social assistance, a pension with a compensatory supplement or a pension, unemployment benefit or emergency assistance of at most the standard rate of § 293 ASVG, and those in debt settlement proceedings until the payment period or the skimming-off procedure ends. The same holds for students with a study grant, apprentices paid at most that rate, persons exempt from the broadcasting fee or receiving the telephone fee subsidy, homeless persons, asylum seekers and foreigners whose stay is tolerated.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Treat consumers in comparable situations in another EU member state as especially vulnerable for the reduced fee cap
obligations.sourceLabel: Rechtsinformationssystem des Bundes (RIS), Festlegung von Gruppen sozial oder wirtschaftlich besonders schutzbedürftiger Verbraucher (VZKG-V), BGBl. II Nr. 255/2016, § 1 Z 13, consolidated text read through the RIS open-data interface

titles.en: Treat consumers in comparable situations in another EU member state as especially vulnerable for the reduced fee cap

summaries.en: The reduced cap also applies to consumers who, in another member state of the European Union, have a status equal to homelessness, asylum seeking or tolerated stay, receive a social benefit comparable to minimum income or a compensatory supplement, receive statutory unemployment benefit below that state's reference rate for such a benefit, are subject to insolvency proceedings comparable to debt settlement, or receive a state study grant tied to social need.
